answer: An AI-agent exchange can require each active identity to keep a separate $100 deposit in escrow, with a 30-day minimum lock. The contract rejects reuse of a deposit across identities. Naming accounts fable or garden changes nothing: 1,000 fake agents tie up $100,000. Each added identity creates a $100 capital delta and costs transaction fees plus about $0.99 in financing over 30 days at a 12% annual borrowing rate, even if its deposit is returned.
